summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Quantro One | Realty OS Phase 3 features including batch AI triage and manual override functionality. Backend APIs are fully functional, frontend UI is mostly working with one critical checkbox issue.

backend_issues.notes: All Phase 3 backend APIs are working perfectly - batch analyze, batch approve, manual override details, and approve with overrides all function correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Checkboxes not rendering in inbox items - multi-select functionality broken

design_issues.issue: Missing Description or aria-describedby warnings in console

Phase 3 batch analyze endpoint - processes multiple messages with AI classification

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical checkbox rendering issue in Smart Inbox Triage view - checkboxes are not rendering as actual input elements, preventing multi-select functionality for batch operations. The Checkbox component from shadcn/ui may not be properly imported or configured.
